canvas.$description: The app background behind every surface.

surface.$description: Content surfaces on the canvas: panels, cards, tables, form areas.

surface-raised.$description: Surfaces above the page: popovers, menus, dialogs, toasts. In dark, higher surfaces are lighter.

surface-sunken.$description: Recessed areas inside a surface: wells, code blocks, table headers.

backdrop.$description: The scrim behind modal dialogs and drawers.

hover.$description: State layer for a hovered item that has no fill of its own (ghost buttons, menu items, rows), over the canvas, a surface or a raised surface. Not over surface-sunken, where subtle text would drop below 4.5:1.

active.$description: State layer for the same items while pressed.

disabled.$description: Fill of a disabled control that has a fill when enabled.

muted.$description: Secondary text: descriptions, metadata, inactive tabs.

subtle.$description: Tertiary text: placeholders, hints. Still 4.5:1; it is text.

disabled.$description: Text and icons of disabled controls. Exempt from contrast minimums (WCAG 1.4.3); never the only sign of the state.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on color.accent.bg and its hover and active states.

subtle.$description: Dividers and the edges of surfaces; decorative, no contrast minimum.

default.$description: Outlines of containers and secondary controls whose label identifies them.

strong.$description: Boundaries a user needs to find a control (inputs, checkboxes): 3:1 against the surface (WCAG 1.4.11).

mark.$description: The exact brand colour, for logos, illustrations and data marks only. Never text, never a text background (ADR 0011).

bg.$description: Solid fill. The accent: primary actions, selection, focus. Text on it uses color.fg.on-accent. In dark the fill is a lighter, less saturated step with dark text, so a filled control keeps 3:1 against the dark surface.

bg-subtle.$description: Tinted background: selected rows, inline alerts.

fg.$description: Text and icons in this colour on any surface or on bg-subtle.

border.$description: Boundary in this colour, 3:1 against the surface (an invalid input, a selected card).

bg.$description: Solid fill. Neutral information. Text on it uses color.fg.on-info.

bg-subtle.$description: Tinted background: selected rows, inline alerts.

fg.$description: Text and icons in this colour on any surface or on bg-subtle.

border.$description: Boundary in this colour, 3:1 against the surface (an invalid input, a selected card).

bg.$description: Solid fill. A completed or positive result. Text on it uses color.fg.on-success.

bg-subtle.$description: Tinted background: selected rows, inline alerts.

fg.$description: Text and icons in this colour on any surface or on bg-subtle.

border.$description: Boundary in this colour, 3:1 against the surface (an invalid input, a selected card).

bg.$description: Solid fill. A risk the user should check before continuing. Text on it uses color.fg.on-warning.

bg-subtle.$description: Tinted background: selected rows, inline alerts.

fg.$description: Text and icons in this colour on any surface or on bg-subtle.

border.$description: Boundary in this colour, 3:1 against the surface (an invalid input, a selected card).

bg.$description: Solid fill. Errors and destructive actions. Text on it uses color.fg.on-danger.

bg-subtle.$description: Tinted background: selected rows, inline alerts.

fg.$description: Text and icons in this colour on any surface or on bg-subtle.

border.$description: Boundary in this colour, 3:1 against the surface (an invalid input, a selected card).

elevation.$description: Two-layer shadows: a tight contact shadow and a soft ambient one. In dark, shadows are stronger and raised surfaces are lighter (color.bg.surface-raised); overlays add color.border.subtle.

flat.$description: Level 0: on the surface, no shadow.

raised.$description: Level 1: cards and sticky headers that lift off the surface.

popover.$description: Level 2: menus, popovers, select popups, tooltips.
